en.title: Join Us Drops 11 Minutes of Cult-Building Gameplay Ahead of 2027 Launch
en.summary: Prepare to lead your own flock of devoted followers in Join Us, an upcoming open-world co-op simulator. New gameplay footage offers an extensive look at the darkly satirical survival/action title.
en.body:
The tantalizing prospect of establishing your own doomsday cult is inching closer to reality. Developer **Wolf Haus Games** has unveiled over 11 minutes of exclusive gameplay for their upcoming open-world co-op title, **Join Us**, offering players a substantial glimpse into the mechanics of leading a devoted — or perhaps dangerously misguided — flock. This extended look arrived as part of **IGN's** gamescom 2026 coverage, giving fans a deep dive into what it takes to keep followers happy and the cult thriving.

**Join Us** promises a darkly satirical survival and action experience, where players will navigate the precarious art of cult leadership. The core loop appears to revolve around recruitment, resource management, and maintaining the faith of your followers. As the developers themselves put it, "a cult leader without any followers is just a lonely weirdo." This highlights the critical importance of player engagement with their virtual congregants; failure to keep recruits content will inevitably lead to them abandoning the cause. The game is slated for a March 2027 release on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and, as recently confirmed, PlayStation 5, with robust 4-player co-op planned for both campaign and free-roam modes.

## A Deeper Look at the Flock

The newly released gameplay footage dives into the nitty-gritty of building and managing a cult. Players will need to be vigilant, constantly working to satisfy the diverse needs and desires of their followers. Whether it’s providing spiritual guidance, ensuring material comfort, or perhaps engaging in more clandestine activities, keeping the flock together is paramount. The satire seems to stem from the inherent absurdity of these demands and the often-unpredictable nature of human belief. The game aims to blend survival elements with action, suggesting that external threats and internal dissent will both pose significant challenges to the aspiring cult leader.

## Real Lives, Virtual Faith

Adding a fascinating layer to the game's promotion, **Wolf Haus Games** also released a special video featuring four individuals who have personal experience with cults. **Jaga, Javier, Ariel, and Elena**, who collectively have over 50 years of experience within "unique societies," were invited to play **Join Us** in co-op. Their reactions and reflections on their past histories while engaging with the game offer a unique perspective on the themes explored. The video showcases their experiences, which range from a cult anticipating alien arrivals to a martial arts-focused community and a holistic rejuvenation group. This initiative blurs the lines between game promotion and genuine exploration of the subject matter, potentially resonating deeply with players intrigued by the psychological and social dynamics of cults.

## What's Next

With the March 2027 release date now firmly established across multiple platforms, fans can anticipate further gameplay reveals and developer insights as **Wolf Haus Games** gears up for launch. The inclusion of former cult members in promotional material suggests a commitment to exploring the complexities of the subject matter in a way that is both engaging and thought-provoking.

content_raw: Join Us, the upcoming open-world co-op game where you can start your very own doomsday cult, just dropped a ton of new gameplay as part of IGN's gamescom programming. You can see more than 11 minutes of exclusive footage in the player below, and get a deeper look into just how the game will work. Earlier this week, developer Wolf Haus games announced that the darkly satirical survival/action cult simulator will be available on PS5 at launch alongside the PC and Xbox Series X/S versions in March 2027. The news of Join Us' PS5 version also featured information on how 4-player co-op will work in both the campaign and free roam. In addition to the extended gameplay, IGN can exclusively reveal a special video from Wolf Haus showing four real-life former cult members coming together to play Join Us in co-op and reflicting on their past histories while enjoying this new adventure and reacting to the game The live-action trailer featuring former cult members, which you can watch below, introduces us to Jaga, Javier, Ariel, and Elena - who have a "collective experience of over 50 years in their unique societies." This experience involves a cult that is preparing for aliens to arrive on Earth and take us back to the planet we came from, a peaceful cult that focuses on martial arts and self-defense training, and a holistic rejuvenation cult. In Join Us, players will need to stay vigilant though, as they'll need to keep their recruits happy or they will leave the cult. As the devs put it, "a cult leader without any followers is just a lonely weirdo." For more from gamescom, be sure to check out everything that was revealed during Opening Night Live.
